L.N. 248 of 2024
CLIMATE ACTION ACT, 2024
(ACT No. XVI of 2024)
(CAP. 643)
Commencement Notice
IN EXERCISE of the powers conferred by article 1(2) of the
Climate Action Act, 2024, the Minister responsible for climate action
policy has established the date of publication of this Legal Notice as
the date on which all the provisions of the said Act shall come into
force.
